question: A printing company had 217 sheets of special paper. During the morning, the order multiplied by 7 times. By noon, that amount was multiplied by 8 times again. In the afternoon, 43 more sheets arrived. Then they sent out 3234 sheets to customers. How many sheets of paper remained in inventory?

A juice stand started the morning with 105 cups. By mid-morning, business was booming and orders multiplied by 5. The owner added 59 more cups to the inventory. At lunch, orders again multiplied by 7. Then he sold 1249 cups. He restocked and multiplied by 5 for dinner rush. Finally, he added 49 cups from a delivery. How many cups did the juice stand have after the dinner rush?

A toy store had 19 action figures in stock. During a sale, they tripled to 57 figures. Then 52 figures were sold to customers. Another 13 figures were damaged and removed. The store restocked and multiplied by 5 for the holiday season. How many action figures does the store have now?

A restaurant started with 184 plates. During breakfast, orders multiplied by 7. They received 54 new plates from supplies. They got 64 more plates from another delivery. They prepared twice as many meals, so multiplied by 8. They then organized for a catering event, multiplying by 6. The chef noticed they had served 200 people, which was unrelated. How many plates does the restaurant have after all preparation?

A florist had 33 flowers at opening. She used 29 flowers for a wedding arrangement. She received 6 new flowers in a morning delivery. She used 11 more flowers for a centerpiece. She then prepared 4 bouquets, each needing her stock multiplied by 4. She added 61 flowers for a special event. How many flowers did the florist have after all arrangements?

A baker had 78 cookies. She used 69 for a catering event. She made 50 new cookies in the afternoon. She added 7 more from a previous batch. She divided the total into groups of 6 for gift boxes. She then multiplied by 5 for the next day's prep. She had 56 cookies already reserved, which was separate. She finally added 56 more baked cookies. How many cookies did she have?

A store had 133 items to sell. They tripled inventory to 399. Then 237 items were sold. The store received 58 new items. They then lost 159 items in a warehouse issue. How many items remain in inventory?

A construction team had 189 bricks. They multiplied by 6 for a large order. Then they multiplied by 2 again. They divided by 3 to share among three teams. Each team added 79 more bricks. They received 50 additional bricks from a supplier. They then multiplied the total by 7 for a major project. How many bricks did they have?

A coach had 79 tennis balls. He used 38 for practice. He added 50 from new purchases. He received 65 more from donations. He multiplied by 9 to prepare multiple sets. He multiplied by 4 again for tournaments. His colleague also has 45 balls, which he keeps separate. How many balls did the coach have?

A restaurant started with 126 plates. They received 66 more plates. They organized and multiplied by 9 for the dinner rush. They multiplied by 7 again for a banquet. They added 17 premium plates for special tables. They sold 80 plates, which is unrelated to the final count. How many plates does the restaurant have?

A warehouse had 179 boxes. They removed 126 damaged boxes. They removed 36 more during inventory. They multiplied by 8 for reorganization. They multiplied by 9 again for shipment prep. They divided by 6 to create shipping units. They added 55 premium boxes. The storage facility housed 200 total pallets, which is unrelated. How many boxes do they have?

A bookstore had 101 books. They removed 79 slow sellers. They multiplied by 3 for new stock. They removed 37 damaged copies. They multiplied by 5 for online orders. They multiplied by 2 again for distribution. They removed 263 books that were recalled. How many books remain?

A orchard started with 86 apple trees. They planted and multiplied by 3. They multiplied by 4 again. They added 30 new saplings. They removed 946 old diseased trees from the back section. They removed 61 more to clear land. How many trees does the orchard have?

A warehouse began with 220 boxes. They added 69 more boxes from a shipment. They multiplied by 5 for a reorganization. They multiplied by 5 again for another reorganization. They multiplied by 5 once more. They added 9 special boxes. They multiplied by 8 for the final shipping prep. About a dozen boxes were damaged, which is unrelated. How many boxes are ready for shipment?

A musician had 191 sheet music pages. She received 80 more from a composer. She gave away 228 pages to students. She received 27 more at a concert. She found 7 more in a drawer. She lost 6 pages from rain damage. How many pages does she have now?

A gardener had 139 flower seeds. She multiplied by 5 for spring planting. She added 79 more from a new package. She added 52 seeds from a gift. She multiplied by 9 for propagation planning. She added 5 rare seeds. Nearby, a neighbor also plants 30 seeds annually, which is separate. How many seeds does the gardener have?

A warehouse began with 96 large boxes. They multiplied by 8 for shipment prep. They removed 218 boxes for sorting. They added 57 new boxes. They added 40 more boxes from a supplier. How many boxes are left in the warehouse?

A store had 220 items in stock. They removed 172 slow sellers. They added 36 new items. They multiplied by 4 for a promotional layout. They multiplied by 7 again. They divided by 6 to organize into equal sections. How many items are in each section?

A collector had 233 coins. She spent 207 on an auction. She lost 8 coins from her collection. She found 9 coins at a flea market. She multiplied by 5 to organize sets. How many coins does the collector have now?

A baker started with 21 cookies. She gave away 13 to friends. She baked 40 more in the morning. She added 33 from an afternoon batch. She then removed 25 that burned. Her neighbor brought 18 cookies, which was separate. How many cookies does the baker have?

A student had 31 pencils. She added 46 more from school supplies. She added 21 from a friend. She gave away 84 to classmates. She lost 6 at recess. She broke 7 more by accident. She found 10 in her backpack. How many pencils does she have now?
A printer had 214 sheets of paper. They multiplied by 7 for a large job. They used 268 sheets. They multiplied by 9 for the next project. They added 75 premium sheets. How many sheets are available?

A cook had 208 eggs. He multiplied by 2 to prepare for a catering event. He added 70 more eggs. He multiplied by 8 for a large order. He added 22 more. He multiplied by 9 for a banquet. He divided by 3 to share among kitchens. How many eggs per kitchen?

A student had 71 marbles. She gave away 56. She gave away 4 more. She gave away 8 additional marbles. She found 51 new marbles. She multiplied by 2 to prepare sets. An exhibit displayed 200 marbles, which was separate. How many marbles does she have?

A child had 26 toys. He gave away 16. He gave away 6 more. He received 20 new toys. He received 6 more toys. He organized into groups, multiplying by 3. He divided in half to share with a sibling. How many toys does he have?
